title: Overlay sponsor card response (PRF-02 slice 7, catalogue module #11)
description: The overlay-facing projection of a channel's sponsor card, scoped by the overlay session token. THE CARD RENDERS THE SPONSOR AND COUNTS NOTHING (owner decision, 2026-09-17) -- the exposure event log named in the original catalogue row is DROPPED, not narrowed. There is no impression, exposure, view, duration, 'shown at' or 'displayed at' field anywhere on this path, and none exists in the schema behind it either. A row is returned ONLY when the card is currently supposed to be visible: enabled, and inside its schedule window if it has one. A null sponsorCard is what a disabled card, a card outside its schedule, an unrecognised/expired/revoked/foreign overlay token, and a channel with no sponsor card at all all return -- every one of them means paint nothing. The logo, when present, is a tenant-scoped content-addressed asset reference (channel id + sha256, section 19.1) -- never a URL, never third-party content, and nothing capable of reaching the Master Canvas as a script, iframe or stylesheet (section 9.1.1).

sponsorName.description: The sponsor name the card paints. Bound reused from the challenge-title bound (migration 0109 line 67).

logoMimeType.description: Present only alongside logoStorageKey -- the logo is optional and both are null together or set together.

logoStorageKey.description: A tenant-scoped content-addressed asset reference (channelId + '/' + the logo's sha256 content hash, section 19.1) -- never a fetchable URL and never third-party content. Generated by the database, never independently writable.
